reason: An email integration plugin that gives agents IMAP/SMTP tools to list, read, search, send, and manage messages and attachments across configured providers.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供基于 IMAP/SMTP 的邮件收取、阅读、搜索、发送、文件夹管理和附件下载工具。
summaries.en: Provides agents with IMAP/SMTP tools for listing, reading, searching, sending, organizing, and downloading email attachments.

capabilities: Connects to configured IMAP and SMTP email servers
Lists, reads, searches, and organizes mailbox messages
Sends email with optional file attachments
Downloads email attachments to a local workspace
Stores and uses configured email authorization credentials
